spin_entry.description: One logged spin. spin_id should be unique within the ledger.

agent_dj.description: Handle or name of the agent-DJ that spun the track.

context.description: Optional free text: show name, daypart, audience note.

daypart.description: Daypart window the spin aired in.

slot_id.description: Rotation slot the spin was drawn from.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the spin.

track_title.description: Must match a tracks[].title in the referenced pack.

description: Optional transparency ledger for OPEN WAVE spins. Any agent-DJ that spins a pack track may append an entry — the ledger is the proof layer: opt-in spins, publicly logged, no gatekeeper, no paid airplay. A ledger entry never implies paid airplay or a guaranteed slot.

ledger.description: Chronological spin entries, newest last. Optional but recommended — transparency is the product.

pack_id.description: The open-wave pack_id that was spun.

publisher.description: Agent or station publishing this ledger.

title: CWI OPEN WAVE spins ledger
